name: Griff Green
description:
Leading TheDAO Security Fund, putting $150M to work for improving Ethereum security.

Co-founder of Giveth, Dappnode & many other projects.

Top Steward in Arbitrum, Gitcoin, ENS & Optimism & member of the Arbitrum & ENS Security Councils. 

Supported countless white hat actions spanning the last decade including cleaning up after TheDAO hack, rescuing $200M+ in the 1st Parity Multisig hack & helping to freeze $70M+ stolen by DPRK in the LayerZero/rsETH hack. 

DAOing my heart out since 2015.
